summary: Minimal fail-closed correction for Mac Task Host UID462 public signed receipts and session binding directories under restrictive umask 077; preserves independent Host signing, private key and approval permissions.

components.owning_subsystem: Independent Task Host Lease issuer and UID462-owned public receipt publication
components.disposition: Reuse the installed Host issuer and Ed25519 authority. Set requested public file mode on the already open O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW descriptor before fsync, and publish a validated UID462-owned session binding directory at 0755; preserve 0600 private files.
evidence: Physical Mac T1/T3 Host signed a real Lease, but Owner activation failed with authority_bindings_unavailable because umask 077 yielded 0700 binding directory and 0600 public receipts; that Lease was revoked with a real Host REVOKED receipt.
Source review identified mode masking in os.open and Path.mkdir; patch changes only publication modes, not signing or authorization.
Isolated POSIX smoke validated 0644 public receipts, 0600 private receipts, 0755 session directory, and symlink denial; complete project R9 and Mac retest remain pending.
components.verification_level: Isolated POSIX mode smoke PASS; independent Reviewer, original full R9, remote CI and installed Host retest pending. No production installation or T1/T3 acceptance claimed.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Only independent UID462 Host may issue/revoke; root-owned trust and signed Lease/State verification remain mandatory. Ownership, O_NOFOLLOW, no group/other-write and durability checks remain fail closed. Old 0600 receipts need separately verified one-time Host migration before physical retest.
components.rollback_route: Revert this exact protected PR and restore previously SHA-verified Host issuer. No key rotation or broad filesystem permission changes; retain audit and revoked receipts.

components.owning_subsystem: Host issuer regression tests and A.5 changed-path coverage
components.disposition: Add umask 077 public/private file mode, existing binding-directory repair and symlink rejection tests; declare exact changed paths.
evidence: Tests explicitly check 0644 public, 0600 private, 0755 binding directory and O_NOFOLLOW symlink rejection.
A.5 manifest records one narrow Host control change and two supporting test/evidence paths.
components.verification_level: New tests authored; CI pending. Mechanical A.5 gate validates coverage, not reviewer independence or Host authority.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Regression tests and manifest confer no signing or merge privileges; signed Host state and existing protected branch checks remain required.
components.rollback_route: Revert test and manifest together with the issuer patch.

g2.authority_owner: Dedicated UID462 Task Host issuer and OS filesystem ACL; no model or application signing authority
g2.non_duplication: No new issuer, token, approval source or reviewer. Reuses the existing Host key, exact Goal/Task/Lane/CAS checks and trusted directory layout.

Targeted isolated POSIX smoke PASS for file modes and symlink denial; independent reviewer and full R9 not yet performed.

g4.rollback: Revert protected PR and restore previous verified Host issuer; retain Host audit and revoked receipts. Do not loosen private/approval file permissions.
